paired.normalization: Named editor checkpoints compare normalized editor text and the final provider-visible user message. Full-cell theme, control-sequence and transcript-status differences remain recorded rather than normalized.

findings.observation: The paired run has 19,492 total cell/state differences, 10,194 canonical render differences and 485 control-boundary differences. Pinned Pi writes normal-buffer setup bytes before entering the alternate screen; PiSharp enters the alternate screen first. PiSharp also renders the /reload completion status in the transcript at the reload checkpoint where the pinned Pi frame is empty.
findings.impact: None of these differences change editor text, cursor-visible lifecycle, terminal restoration, or the submitted provider message.

findings.observation: Pinned Pi delegates word boundaries to Intl.Segmenter (ICU). For 你好世界, Ctrl+W deletes 世界 and Alt+D deletes 你好; PiSharp treats the contiguous Han run as one word.
findings.impact: The required M12 contract covers grapheme clusters, combining characters and multiline boundaries. ICU dictionary-based CJK word breaking needs an ICU segmentation dependency or embedded dictionary and remains a documented, non-required finding.
